 Download Festival reveal 2027 lineup including headliners blink-182, Bring Me The Horizon and Evanescence
 The announcement came during a special event at London's Alexandra Palace 
 By Max Persad | 13 November 2026 share: Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on WhatsApp Share on LinkedIn Share on Reddit Share via Email 
 Download Festival have confirmed their line-up for 2027 including headliners blink-182 , Bring Me The Horizon and Evanescence .  
 Revealed last night at London's Alexandra Palace (12 November) during a special event, this will be the 24th edition of the festival with more than 100 bands and artists already confirmed to perform.  
 It will be the first time blink-182 have performed at the festival, with Bring Me The Horizon returning to the event after attending in 2023. Evanescence also make history by becoming only the second female-led band to headline. The group, fronted by Amy Lee, secured a Top 10 in the Official Albums Chart in August with their sixth LP, Sanctuary .  
 The festival will return to its usual venue of Donnington Park in Derby and will run from Wednesday, 9 June till Sunday, 13 June. 
 Other acts also announced include 5 Seconds of Summer ,  Turnstile , PRESIDENT , The Prodigy , Basement and many, many more.  
 There are still more acts to be announced according to promoters, with some special "surprises" also on the horizon.  
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by Download Festival (@downloadfest) 
 Early Bird tickets have already sold-out, with promoters saying this is the fastest selling Download to date. You can access other ticket variations here .  
 2026's Download saw Limp Bizkit , Guns N' Roses and Linkin Park top the bill.
